title: IronZ brain acceptance cases
scope: Synthetic public scenarios. Private reference evaluation follows separate owner-private protocol.

cases.name: Goals survive adapters
cases.given: Synthetic athlete selects a faster running goal and a lead-in preference; traverse wizard/direct/import contracts. Include target profile adapter defaults, separate wizard storage keys and legacy/target race enum variants.
cases.required_result: Goal and lead-in preserved or unsupported choice explained; no silently stamped experience override. Missing body facts remain unknown; equivalent events normalize identically.

cases.name: Units and sport capacity
cases.given: Equivalent metric/imperial inputs; strong cyclist with novice running history. Vary present/unknown age and sex fields only under supported policy; include normalized legacy/target race enum variants.
cases.required_result: Same decisions after conversion; running load reflects running history, not overall highest sport label. Any age/sex-dependent behavior follows reviewed policy with traceability, not implicit engine disagreement.

cases.name: Unknown recovery
cases.given: Absent, malformed, partial and stale check-ins, including old field aliases.
cases.required_result: Explicit unknown/coverage; no good-recovery fallback, false green or wearable-driven increase.

cases.name: Conflicting and late observations
cases.given: Duplicate activities and incomplete wellness arrive in different orders.
cases.required_result: Idempotent normalized facts, provenance and late-data correction; unchanged facts give unchanged decisions.

cases.name: Reported restrictions
cases.given: Synthetic discipline-specific medical restriction plus pending/easy/unrestricted reports.
cases.required_result: Blocked work remains ineligible; elapsed time and athlete approval cannot invent clearance; conflicts hold.

cases.name: Athlete preferences
cases.given: Same endurance goal with support-strength, hybrid and primary-strength choices; all other inputs fixed.
cases.required_result: Role persists and affects plan within constraints; unsupported trade-off explained.

cases.name: Availability and direct entry points
cases.given: Four selected days, running only, future start and facility closure; test every generation/edit path.
cases.required_result: All actual saved training respects days/sports/start/duration/facilities after all transformations.

cases.name: Starting load provenance
cases.given: No recent history, zero-load week, older high peak and current low tolerated work.
cases.required_result: Explicit provisional start or missing-input hold; no imaginary historical baseline, division by zero or catch-up.

cases.name: Season and secondary event
cases.given: Synthetic distant A race and nearer secondary hybrid event.
cases.required_result: A-race arc and taper preserved; secondary preparation replaces within budget; race priorities explicit.

cases.name: Recovery and taper preservation
cases.given: Evaluate normal, shortened, interrupted and recovering arcs; compare percentage denominators. Include the target intermediate 100-to-115-minute progression and current-master-policy conflict.
cases.required_result: Reviewed sport/phase policy enforced on actual totals; no generic return percentage treated as clearance. Policy disagreement blocks activation; constants cannot silently override approved method. Assertions identify the approved policy ID/version and validate actual key-session steps as well as weekly totals.

cases.name: Purposeful variation
cases.given: Repeat identical generation then advance to another training week.
cases.required_result: Reproducible fixed-seed output; variation preserves purpose, progression and comparable benchmarks.

cases.name: Infeasible and unsupported inputs
cases.given: Impossible availability or unsupported event/goal produces no usable training.
cases.required_result: Explicit infeasibility and options; prior plan retained; no false success, invented capacity or surprise sport.

cases.name: Structured prescription integrity
cases.given: Test running intervals, bike sets, swim units/rest steps, strength and brick sessions.
cases.required_result: Targets, caps, steps and displayed totals agree; component load counted correctly; final validation follows transforms.

cases.name: Executed version grading
cases.given: Session changed after athlete started; activity syncs against the older executed version.
cases.required_result: Grade against executed prescription; ambiguous match asks rather than guessing.

cases.name: Data quality and environment
cases.given: Missing HR, cadence lock suspicion, swim-distance discrepancy and heat change.
cases.required_result: Qualified or withheld grade; no claim of poor adherence or fitness diagnosis from insufficient evidence.

cases.name: Real reduction
cases.given: Recommend easier work for a structured hard session in each sport.
cases.required_result: New actual steps/targets/duration; no stale hard library/test/lifting payload under an easy label.

cases.name: Permission and independent controls
cases.given: Feedback on/off, coach on/off, mutation consent absent/revoked, explicit decline.
cases.required_result: Proposal-first; no unauthorized mutation/export; notification preference never grants plan-write permission.

cases.name: Stale and expired approval
cases.given: Approve a proposal after another plan revision, new restriction or proposal expiry.
cases.required_result: Reject stale commit and request current review; no overwritten plan or newly ineligible session.

cases.name: Unanswered proposal
cases.given: Session time passes without response; test both otherwise eligible plan and new hard restriction.
cases.required_result: Retain only last approved eligible prescription; ineligible original held, no unapproved substitute adopted.

cases.name: Wearable enthusiasm and uncertainty
cases.given: Favorable wearable trend alone; then disagreeing subjective recovery report.
cases.required_result: No automatic increase or manufactured risk percentage; explain evidence and propose supported options.

cases.name: Missing activity is not missed work
cases.given: Late activity import and athlete-reported completed strength with no device file.
cases.required_result: Coverage and report provenance shown; no premature noncompliance; deduplicate later matching upload.

cases.name: Honest improvement trend
cases.given: Comparable benchmark changes versus different weather, route or threshold version.
cases.required_result: Separate observed change from inference; no guaranteed improvement or causal certainty; preserve uncertainty.

cases.name: Weekly draft and approvals
cases.given: Review creates next-week draft; athlete declines or never responds.
cases.required_result: Current plan/delivery unchanged, draft remains visible with reason and history; acceptance creates one version.

cases.name: Missed work and recovery priority
cases.given: Several missed sessions, busy day and unresolved recovery need.
cases.required_result: No cramming/catch-up; constraints preserved; goal feasibility explained and next-week alternatives proposed.

cases.name: Grounded final explanation
cases.given: Validator moves/removes sessions after rationale generation; explanatory AI fails or invents a target.
cases.required_result: Explain final validated facts; deterministic fallback; fabricated wording never changes or overrides prescription.

cases.name: Atomic failures and identity switch
cases.given: Generation empty/throws, save rejected, cache fills late or account switches during request. Also report a new hard restriction while its save is rejected.
cases.required_result: No false success or partial replacement; prior plan preserved or acknowledged-server/reload state explicit; no account leak. Preserve immutable history, but visibly hold now-ineligible work, warn that restriction is unsaved, block local starts/exports and disclose incomplete cross-device propagation.

cases.name: Two devices and retries
cases.given: Stale browser writes, duplicate approval, job retry and simultaneous weekly approval.
cases.required_result: Expected revision and idempotency allow one commit; stale data cannot overwrite newer approved state.

cases.name: History and restriction reconciliation
cases.given: Edit/delete future workout, alter restriction, import updated plan and correct older observation.
cases.required_result: Manual changes/completed history preserved; no resurrected deletion, repeated halving or unrecorded rewritten decision.

cases.name: Notification and delivery truth
cases.given: Timezone/DST change, quiet hours, channels off, retrying/failed calendar or watch export.
cases.required_result: Consent and local schedule honored, no duplicate delivery; external status accurate and separate from approved plan. Old copies made ineligible by a restriction show stale/do-not-follow and update/removal pending; no unverified remote recall claim.
cases.critical_when: A stale destination prescription is made ineligible by a restriction, or notification/delivery discloses private data without authorization. Apply the global critical gate, not the generic delivery-major classification.

cases.name: Private data and instruction boundaries
cases.given: Other athlete requests records; imported workout note contains instructions; provider consent revoked.
cases.required_result: No cross-user access/health analytics/public fixture/unauthorized provider transfer; imported text cannot alter policy; revoked retrieval stops.
